name: iae
description: Incremental AI Engineering: specify, design, decompose, implement, test and adapt software changes in small validated increments.

interface.longDescription: Turn ambiguous software work into a specification, an incremental technical design, executable subphases and a controlled implementation loop with explicit manual validation gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $iae:specify to clarify this software change.
Use $iae:design to turn the IAE specification into incremental phases.
Use $iae:loop to execute the next IAE subphase.
